name: MonarchAiMessageBranch
title: AiMessageBranch
summary: The previous, position, next switcher between versions of a message, made when a reply is regenerated or a prompt is edited and resent.
whenToUse: Under a message that has more than one version.
whenNotToUse: For pages of a list use a pager or a pagination control. For a choice between named options use a segmented button.
api: @Composable fun MonarchAiMessageBranch(selection: Int, count: Int, onSelectionChange: (Int) -> Unit, previousIcon: @Composable () -> Unit, nextIcon: @Composable () -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, enabled: Boolean = true, showSingle: Boolean = false, label: String? = null, previousLabel: String? = null, nextLabel: String? = null, formatPosition: ((Int, Int) -> String)? = null, formatAnnouncement: ((Int, Int) -> String)? = null)

options.name: count
options.description: How many versions exist. Below 1 is treated as 1.

options.name: onSelectionChange
options.description: Called with the version to show, counted from 0.

options.name: previousIcon
options.description: The icon of the previous button, a chevron to the start. Monarch bundles no icons; use MonarchIcon with mirrorInRtl = true.

options.name: nextIcon
options.description: The icon of the next button, a chevron to the end.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether the buttons can be used, for example false while a reply streams.

options.name: showSingle
options.description: Shows the switcher when there is only one version.

options.name: formatPosition
options.description: The visible position from the version, counted from 1, and the count. Built in: "2 / 3" (monarch_aimessagebranch_position).

options.name: formatAnnouncement
options.description: The position as TalkBack reads it. Built in: "Version 2 of 3" (monarch_aimessagebranch_announcement).

states.name: disabled
states.description: Both buttons are disabled and the position uses the disabled text color.

states.name: hidden
states.description: With fewer than two versions nothing is shown, unless showSingle is true.

appearance: The position uses the caption type in the muted text color and the buttons the muted text color; disabled parts use the disabled text color, in every theme.
platformNotes: The web takes index and onChange and iOS a Binding; Android takes selection and onSelectionChange, the Compose convention. The chevrons are slots because Monarch bundles no icons; the web draws its own. The group label is the content description of the row, a TalkBack stop of its own. As on the web, when the button that had keyboard focus becomes disabled at an end, focus moves to the other button.
accessibility: The row is a traversal group with the content description "Versions".
The buttons are Material 3 icon buttons named "Previous version" and "Next version", each with a 48dp touch target.
The position shows "2 / 3" and TalkBack reads it as "Version 2 of 3".
After a button changes the version, the position is a polite live region, so the new position is announced; a change made by the app is not announced.
Previous comes before next in reading order in both layout directions.
edgeCases: A selection outside the range shows the nearest version; a step then starts from the version shown.
Large counts widen the position; it does not wrap and the buttons keep their size.
The icons must mirror themselves in right-to-left layouts; the component does not flip them.
